observations.title: Dead guidance in claude-code-token-present hint
observations.rationale: Hint currently says 'specrunner login --provider claude' which this request targets for replacement with 'credentials set claude-code'. Confirmed the check already returns warn (not fail) and required:false, so the behavioral fix is just the hint text.

observations.title: No Ready-to-run message when fail==0
observations.rationale: Requirement 4 adds a 'Ready to run.' + next step line when fail==0. Currently the formatter ends at the summary line with no readiness message. The formatter.ts will need to call a new deriveNextSteps-equivalent for the success path.

observations.title: Migration message for --provider claude cannot reach handler
observations.rationale: If provider is removed from login's flag def, `login --provider claude` throws FlagParseError before the handler. Request correctly defers the solution (legacy argv interception vs deprecated-flag concept) to design step.
